title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_puppy_love_by_rachel_renee_russell_7ae7c (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_puppy_love_by_rachel_renee_russell_7ae7c' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected system should be rotated immediately from a different, trusted computer. Removal of the package alone may not fully eliminate the malicious presence, as the attacker may have established persistent control.
